finding: Retraining the strong configs on the full trainval (train+val, 14608 rows) HURTS 2023-25 test generalization. Adding the 2021-22 val years to the training set poisons cluster-0 (73% of test rows): its test RMSE degrades monotonically after ~epoch 22, and even the best retrain epoch (0.052) is worse than the train-only sweep (0.046-0.049). This is a documented negative result; champion models use the train-only sweep models + offline ensembles.
